company: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
title: Research Assistant
description: Modular Reasoning with Specifications for AI Code Agents, supervised by Dr. Lauren Pick
highlights: Collaborating with a research team to explore large language models (LLMs) for modular reasoning and maximal specification synthesis to assist agentic code generation.
Modified Dafny’s compiler to support outputting function contracts and invariants when cross-compiling to other languages.

Designed and implemented an evaluation pipeline for assessing LLM-generated code on the DafnyBench dataset, incorporating an additional agentic loop to generate formal specifications and use them to guide subsequent code generation.
